entities.summary: James Joseph Walsh, generally referred to as J. J. Walsh, was Postmaster General, of the Irish Free State from 1923 to 1927. He was also a senior Gaelic Athletic Association organiser and Cumann na nGaedheal politician. Later, Walsh had heavy connections with fascism, including his association with Ailtirí na hAiséirghe.
